content.rendered:
​Introducing our Butterfly Royal Bliss, a luxurious butterscotch-flavored cake that promises an indulgent experience. This exquisite creation features layers of moist, buttery sponge infused with rich butterscotch essence, each enveloped in a generous coating of velvety cream. The cake is adorned with delicate, handcrafted butterfly decorations, adding a touch of elegance and whimsy. A drizzle of golden butterscotch sauce cascades over the top, enhancing its decadent appeal. Perfect for celebrations or as a special treat, the Butterfly Royal Bliss offers a harmonious blend of creamy sweetness and buttery richness that will delight your taste buds.​

Product Details:
  • Type: Cream Cake with Butterscotch Flavour
  • Eggless Cake
  • Weight: 1kg
  • Shape: Round |
  • Flavour: Butterscotch | Serves: 7-9 people

NOTE – “WE CAN MAKE THIS DESIGN IN ALL FLAVOURS”

Care Instructions:

  • Store cream cakes in the refrigerator.
  • Fondant cakes should be kept in a cool, air-conditioned space.
  • Serve at room temperature, avoiding heat exposure.
  • Use a serrated knife for cutting fondant cakes.
  • Decorative elements may have toothpicks or wires—check before serving.
  • Consume within 24 hours for best taste.

 

Delivery Information:

  • Cakes are handcrafted; slight variations in design & shape may occur.
  • Delivery time is an estimate based on availability & location.
  • We attempt delivery only once as cakes are perishable.
  • Address changes post-order are not possible.
  • Actual product may slightly differ from the image shown.
  • Hand-delivered, not shipped via courier.
